notes: Midra 4K series (Pulse 4K chosen; Eikos 4K not researched). 10 inputs: 4x HDMI 2.0, 2x DP 1.2, 2x 12G-SDI, 2x multi-plug HDMI 1.4 / 3G-SDI (one active each). 2 PGM outputs HDMI 2.0 with mirrored 12G-SDI.
